neighbours.label: 'easy' or 'perfect' under negation or denial (nobody said it would be easy, no plan is perfect); affirmative uses stay quiet
fire: Let's be honest: nobody promised that this job would be easy.
No system of voting is perfect, and this one has flaws.
The new policy isn't perfect, yet it is an improvement.
No one ever claimed that quitting smoking was easy.
Getting the startup off the ground was never going to be easy.
There is no perfect diet for every person.
Nobody expects the first draft to be perfect.
Moving abroad is not easy, especially with children.
quiet: Honestly, this job turned out to be easy and fun.
No system of voting is simple, and this one has flaws.
The new policy is perfect for small farms.
No one ever claimed that quitting smoking was cheap.
Getting the startup off the ground was easy with their help.
There is no single diet for every person.
She baked a perfect cake for the party.
Moving abroad is not cheap, especially with children.

notes: Probe: negated easy 1.03, negated perfect 0.48-0.56, affirmative easy/perfect <0.03. Near misses: 4 affirmative uses of the words, 4 negations without them.
